units.title: Unit 4 — Society, Ethics & Values
units.description: Social norms, duties, and moral values.

example.hanzi: 冰箱里只有牛奶哦。
example.pinyin: Bīng xiāng lǐ zhǐ yǒu niú nǎi ò.
example.english: There's only milk in the fridge.

example.hanzi: 你明天有什么安排啦？
example.pinyin: Nǐ míng tiān yǒu shén me ān pái la?
example.english: What do you have planned tomorrow?

words.english: Modal particle indicating that sth is obvious

example.hanzi: 他到底想干嘛？
example.pinyin: Tā dào dǐ xiǎng gàn ma?
example.english: What does he want to do?

words.english: The scene (of a crime, accident etc) / (on) the spot

example.hanzi: 警察到达了事故现场。
example.pinyin: Jǐng chá dào dá le shì gù xiàn chǎng.
example.english: The police got to the scene of the accident.

example.hanzi: 没有欲望就等于拥有。
example.pinyin: Méi yǒu yù wàng jiù děng yú yōng yǒu.
example.english: Not wanting is the same as having.

example.hanzi: 哇，这座古老建筑实在太壮观了！
example.pinyin: Wā, zhè zuò gǔ lǎo jiàn zhù shí zài tài zhuàng guān le!
example.english: Wow, this ancient building is truly magnificent!

words.english: To deal; to trade; to transact / transaction; deal

example.hanzi: 我和他达成了交易。
example.pinyin: Wǒ hé tā dá chéng le jiāo yì.
example.english: I made a deal with him.

example.hanzi: 我们对他的死亡表示遗憾。
example.pinyin: Wǒ men duì tā de sǐ wáng biǎo shì yí hàn.
example.english: We regret his death.

example.hanzi: 这是个重要事件。
example.pinyin: Zhè shì gè zhòng yào shì jiàn.
example.english: This is an important event.

example.hanzi: 您下午做啥呢？
example.pinyin: Nín xià wǔ zuò shá ne?
example.english: So what will you do in the afternoon?

example.hanzi: 他是个很棒的网球选手。
example.pinyin: Tā shì gè hěn bàng de wǎng qiú xuǎn shǒu.
example.english: He's an excellent tennis player.

example.hanzi: 所有代表已经通过投票决定了方案。
example.pinyin: Suǒ yǒu dài biǎo yǐ jīng tōng guò tóu piào jué dìng le fāng àn.
example.english: All the representatives have decided on the proposal by voting.

example.hanzi: 我们公司非常尊重每位客户的建议。
example.pinyin: Wǒ men gōng sī fēi cháng zūn zhòng měi wèi kè hù de jiàn yì.
example.english: Our company greatly respects the suggestions of every client.

example.hanzi: 那位老同志为家乡建设贡献了一生。
example.pinyin: Nà wèi lǎo tóng zhì wèi jiā xiāng jiàn shè gòng xiàn le yī shēng.
example.english: That veteran comrade devoted his entire life to building his hometown.

example.hanzi: 他已经意识到它了。
example.pinyin: Tā yǐ jīng yì shí dào tā le.
example.english: He already knew about it.

example.hanzi: 我一得到一大笔钱就捐一部分给慈善机构。
example.pinyin: Wǒ yī dédào yīdàbǐqián jiù juān yībùfèn gěi cí shàn jī gòu.
example.english: Whenever I get a large sum of money, I donate some of it to charity.

example.hanzi: 你有副好嗓音。
example.pinyin: Nǐ yǒu fù hǎo sǎngyīn.
example.english: You have a wonderful voice.

example.hanzi: 他必须继承父亲的事业。
example.pinyin: Tā bì xū jì chéng fù qīn de shì yè.
example.english: He must succeed to his father's business.

example.hanzi: 我相信他的执行能力。
example.pinyin: Wǒ xiāng xìn tā de zhí xíng néng lì.
example.english: I trust his executive ability.

example.hanzi: 我们只是好朋友而已。
example.pinyin: Wǒ men zhǐshì hǎo péng you ér yǐ.
example.english: We're good friends, nothing more.

example.hanzi: 他是学校网球俱乐部的成员。
example.pinyin: Tā shì xué xiào wǎng qiú jù lè bù de chéng yuán.
example.english: He is a member of the tennis club in our school.

example.hanzi: 我喜欢在队伍里。
example.pinyin: Wǒ xǐ huan zài duì wǔ lǐ.
example.english: I like being on the team.

example.hanzi: 警察调查事故的原因。
example.pinyin: Jǐng chá diào chá shì gù de yuán yīn.
example.english: The police are investigating the cause of the accident.

example.hanzi: 把你的武器放下。
example.pinyin: Bǎ nǐ de wǔ qì fàngxià.
example.english: Put your weapon down.

example.hanzi: 我们达成了合伙协议。
example.pinyin: Wǒ men dá chéng le hé huǒ xié yì.
example.english: We have reached a partnership agreement.

example.hanzi: 军队意外地被攻击了。
example.pinyin: Jūn duì yì wài dìbèi gōng jī le.
example.english: The army was unexpectedly attacked.

example.hanzi: 警察会调查这起案件。
example.pinyin: Jǐng chá huì diào chá zhèqǐ àn jiàn.
example.english: The police will look into the case.

example.hanzi: 那部恐怖电影让小王晚上不敢睡觉。
example.pinyin: Nà bù kǒng bù diàn yǐng ràng Xiǎo Wáng wǎn shang bù gǎn shuì jiào.
example.english: That terrifying movie left Xiao Wang too scared to sleep at night.

example.hanzi: 我可以确保成功。
example.pinyin: Wǒ kě yǐ què bǎo chéng gōng.
example.english: I can assure success.

example.hanzi: 在我的邻近区域有一个大超市。
example.pinyin: Zài wǒ de línjìn qū yù yǒu yígè dà chāo shì.
example.english: There's a big supermarket in my neighborhood.

words.english: Double-edged sword / classifier for blows of a sword

example.hanzi: 那把古老的剑收藏在历史博物馆里。
example.pinyin: Nà bǎ gǔ lǎo de jiàn shōu cáng zài lì shǐ bó wù guǎn lǐ.
example.english: That ancient sword is kept in the history museum.

words.english: Household dish, implement or furniture / domestic animal

example.hanzi: 我不喜欢那家伙。
example.pinyin: Wǒ bù xǐ huan nà jiā huo.
example.english: I don't like that guy.

example.hanzi: 爆炸的原因是什么？
example.pinyin: Bào zhà de yuán yīn shì shén me?
example.english: What was the cause of the explosion?

words.english: To reveal; to display; to show; to exhibit

example.hanzi: 可以在地图上展示给我看吗？
example.pinyin: Kě yǐ zài dì tú shàng zhǎn shì gěi wǒ kàn ma?
example.english: Can you show me on the map?

words.english: Base (of operations) / industrial or military base

example.hanzi: 这附近有一个军事基地。
example.pinyin: Zhè fù jìn yǒu yīgè jūnshì jī dì.
example.english: There is a military base near here.

words.english: To fight / to engage in combat

example.hanzi: 这是战斗发生的地方。
example.pinyin: Zhèshì zhàn dòu fā shēng de dì fang.
example.english: This is the place where the battle took place.

example.hanzi: 你为什么要骂人家？
example.pinyin: Nǐ wèi shén me yào mà rén jia?
example.english: Why do you go about being cross at people?

example.hanzi: 军队强迫他辞职。
example.pinyin: Jūn duì qiǎng pò tā cí zhí.
example.english: The army forced him to resign.

example.hanzi: 他因滥用公共基金而被捕。
example.pinyin: Tā yīn lànyòng gōnggòng jī jīn ér bèibǔ.
example.english: He was arrested for abusing public funds.

example.hanzi: 新的社区中心在昨天隆重落成。
example.pinyin: Xīn de shè qū zhōng xīn zài zuó tiān lóng zhòng luò chéng.
example.english: The new community center was inaugurated yesterday with pomp and circumstance.

words.english: On the eve of / to be about to

example.hanzi: 这场谈论即将对污染问题展开讨论。
example.pinyin: Zhèchǎng tánlùn jí jiāng duì wū rǎn wèn tí zhǎn kāi tǎo lùn.
example.english: The talks will deal with the problem of pollution.

example.hanzi: 城市中央有一座公园。
example.pinyin: Chéng shì zhōng yāng yǒu yīzuò gōng yuán.
example.english: There is a park in the middle of the city.

example.hanzi: 古代中国把土地分成许多不同的州。
example.pinyin: Gǔ dài Zhōng guó bǎ tǔ dì fēn chéng xǔ duō bù tóng de zhōu.
example.english: Ancient China divided its territory into many different prefectures.

example.hanzi: 两者之间有显著的差别。
example.pinyin: Liǎngzhězhījiān yǒu xiǎn zhù de chā bié.
example.english: There are noticeable differences between the two.

example.hanzi: 我们被暴风雨袭击了。
example.pinyin: Wǒ men bèi bàofēngyǔ xí jī le.
example.english: We were caught in a storm.

words.english: To promise / to undertake to do something

example.hanzi: 她承诺给我打电话。
example.pinyin: Tā chéng nuò gěi wǒ dǎ diàn huà.
example.english: She's promised to give me a ring.

example.hanzi: 我被他的故事感染了。
example.pinyin: Wǒ bèi tā de gù shi gǎn rǎn le.
example.english: I was very impressed by his story.

example.hanzi: 他砸坏的是这扇窗。
example.pinyin: Tā zá huài de shì zhè shàn chuāng.
example.english: This is the window he broke.

example.hanzi: 它也不在意国会被哪个党控制。
example.pinyin: Tā yě bù zài yì guóhuì bèi nǎge dǎng kòng zhì.
example.english: It doesn't care which party controls your congress.

example.hanzi: 这会打击我们的生意。
example.pinyin: Zhèhuì dǎ jī wǒ men de shēng yì.
example.english: This could hurt our business.

words.english: To shift; to relocate; to transfer

example.hanzi: 这些鸟不转移。
example.pinyin: Zhèxiē niǎo bù zhuǎn yí.
example.english: These birds don't migrate.

example.hanzi: 小李把桌子上的地图仔细卷起来。
example.pinyin: Xiǎo Lǐ bǎ zhuō zi shàng de dì tú zǐ xì juǎn qǐ lái.
example.english: Xiao Li carefully rolled up the map on the table.

example.hanzi: 老鼠是胆小的生物。
example.pinyin: Lǎo shǔ shì dǎnxiǎo de shēng wù.
example.english: A mouse is a timid creature.

example.hanzi: 不少专业人士对这项改革表示赞成。
example.pinyin: Bù shǎo zhuān yè rén shì duì zhè xiàng gǎi gé biǎo shì zàn chéng.
example.english: Many professionals expressed support for this reform.

example.hanzi: 这些集团是混合体。
example.pinyin: Zhèxiē jí tuán shì hùnhétǐ.
example.english: These groups are hybrid.

example.hanzi: 每一种基因都有诊断试验的潜力。
example.pinyin: Měi yīzhǒng jī yīn dōu yǒu zhěn duàn shì yàn de qián lì.
example.english: Each one of these genes has potential diagnostic test.

words.english: To make headway; to make progress

example.hanzi: 你的生意进展如何？
example.pinyin: Nǐ de shēng yì jìn zhǎn rú hé?
example.english: How is your business going?

example.hanzi: 她穿着一条时尚又性感的红色裙子。
example.pinyin: Tā chuān zhe yī tiáo shí shàng yòu xìng gǎn de hóng sè qún zi.
example.english: She was wearing a stylish and alluring red dress.

example.hanzi: 他启发了我最近拍摄的国家公园系列作品。
example.pinyin: Tā qǐ fā le wǒ zuì jìn pāishè de guó jiā gōng yuán xì liè zuò pǐn.
example.english: He inspired a recent series that I did on the National Parks.

example.hanzi: 爬上那座古老的塔就能看见整个城市。
example.pinyin: Pá shàng nà zuò gǔ lǎo de tǎ jiù néng kàn jiàn zhěng gè chéng shì.
example.english: Climbing that ancient pagoda lets you see the entire city.

example.hanzi: 我真的很喜欢看你的视频。
example.pinyin: Wǒ zhēnde hěn xǐ huan kàn nǐ de shì pín.
example.english: I am really enjoying watching your video.

words.english: The truth about sth; the actual facts

example.hanzi: 她没有试图掩盖真相。
example.pinyin: Tā méi yǒu shì tú yǎn gài zhēn xiàng.
example.english: She didn't try to hide the truth.

example.hanzi: 我们搭错飞机了。
example.pinyin: Wǒ men dā cuò fēi jī le.
example.english: You are on the wrong plane.

example.hanzi: 王先生明天将带夫人一起出席宴会。
example.pinyin: Wáng xiān sheng míng tiān jiāng dài fū ren yī qǐ chū xí yàn huì.
example.english: Mr. Wang will attend the banquet together with his wife tomorrow.

words.english: Not in the least / to completely lack

example.hanzi: 没有爱情的生活毫无意义。
example.pinyin: Méi yǒu ài qíng de shēng huó háo wú yì yì.
example.english: Life without love has no meaning at all.

example.hanzi: 她总是尝试新事物。
example.pinyin: Tā zǒng shì cháng shì xīn shì wù.
example.english: She is always trying new things.

example.hanzi: 你也许会染上疾病。
example.pinyin: Nǐ yě xǔ huì rǎnshàng jí bìng.
example.english: You may get a serious disease.

example.hanzi: 我也听过一个类似的故事。
example.pinyin: Wǒ yě tīng guo yígè lèi sì de gù shi.
example.english: I also heard a similar story.

example.hanzi: 工作政策是个失败。
example.pinyin: Gōng zuò zhèng cè shì gè shī bài.
example.english: The employment policy is a failure.

example.hanzi: 你发神经了吗？
example.pinyin: Nǐ fā shén jīng le ma?
example.english: Have you gone nuts?

example.hanzi: 这几家科技公司决定成立合作联盟。
example.pinyin: Zhè jǐ jiā kē jì gōng sī jué dìng chéng lì hé zuò lián méng.
example.english: These technology companies decided to form a cooperative alliance.

example.hanzi: 评论要与主题相关。
example.pinyin: Píng lùn yào yǔ zhǔ tí xiāng guān.
example.english: Comments must be relevant to the topic.

example.hanzi: 开幕仪式将在北京体育馆准时举行。
example.pinyin: Kāi mù yí shì jiāng zài Běi jīng tǐ yù guǎn zhǔn shí jǔ xíng.
example.english: The opening ceremony will be held on time at the Beijing Gymnasium.

example.hanzi: 他们进攻了敌人。
example.pinyin: Tāmen jìn gōng le dí rén.
example.english: They attacked the enemy.

example.hanzi: 什么是您最大的灵感来源？
example.pinyin: Shén me shì nín zuìdà de líng gǎn lái yuán?
example.english: What is your greatest source of inspiration?

example.hanzi: 他自己的生存现在更重要了。
example.pinyin: Tā zì jǐ de shēng cún xiàn zài gèng zhòng yào le.
example.english: His own survival is more important now.

words.english: To get rid of / to remove

example.hanzi: 除我以外每个人都在歌唱。
example.pinyin: Chú wǒ yǐwài měigè rén dōu zài gēchàng.
example.english: Everybody was singing except me.

example.hanzi: 战争并非不可避免。
example.pinyin: Zhàn zhēng bìng fēi bùkěbìmiǎn.
example.english: War is not inevitable.

example.hanzi: 赌博是非法的。
example.pinyin: Dǔ bó shì fēi fǎ de.
example.english: Gambling is illegal.

example.hanzi: 这个想法本身还可以。
example.pinyin: Zhège xiǎngfǎ běn shēn hái kě yǐ.
example.english: The idea is not in itself a bad one.

example.hanzi: 服务员端着热汤小心走向那张桌子。
example.pinyin: Fú wù yuán duān zhe rè tāng xiǎo xīn zǒu xiàng nà zhāng zhuō zi.
example.english: The waiter carefully carried the hot soup toward that table.

example.hanzi: 你度过愉快的时光了吗？
example.pinyin: Nǐ dù guò yú kuài de shí guāng le ma?
example.english: Did you have a good time?

example.hanzi: 他老是给别人扣帽子。
example.pinyin: Tā lǎo shì gěi bié ren kòu mào zi.
example.english: He's always putting labels on people.

example.hanzi: 不要低估自己的实力。
example.pinyin: Búyào dīgū zì jǐ de shí lì.
example.english: Don't underestimate your own strength.

words.english: To confirm (sth to be true) / to verify

example.hanzi: 他被证实是个理想丈夫。
example.pinyin: Tā bèi zhèng shí shì gè lǐ xiǎng zhàng fu.
example.english: He proved to be an ideal husband.

example.hanzi: 我的室友真恶心。
example.pinyin: Wǒ de shìyǒu zhēn ě xīn.
example.english: My roommate is so disgusting.

words.english: To watch attentively / to fix one's attention on

example.hanzi: 别盯着别人看。
example.pinyin: Bié dīng zhe bié ren kàn.
example.english: Don't stare at others.

example.hanzi: 那位勇敢的将军曾经赢得无数胜利。
example.pinyin: Nà wèi yǒng gǎn de jiāng jūn céng jīng yíng dé wú shù shèng lì.
example.english: That brave general once won countless victories.

example.hanzi: 他透露了我的秘密。
example.pinyin: Tā tòu lù le wǒ de mì mì.
example.english: He disclosed my secret.

example.hanzi: 这个城市里有多少居民？
example.pinyin: Zhège chéng shì lǐ yǒu duō shao jū mín?
example.english: How many residents live within this city?

example.hanzi: 这就是发现尸体的房间。
example.pinyin: Zhè jiùshì fā xiàn shī tǐ de fáng jiān.
example.english: This is the room where the body was found.

example.hanzi: 您现已切换至手动呼吸模式。
example.pinyin: Nín xiànyǐ qièhuàn zhì shǒudòng hū xī mó shì.
example.english: You are now breathing manually.

example.hanzi: 天气异常寒冷。
example.pinyin: Tiān qì yì cháng hánlěng.
example.english: The weather is unusually cold.

example.hanzi: 我在下载这份网络档案。
example.pinyin: Wǒ zài xià zǎi zhèfèn wǎng luò dàng àn.
example.english: I'm downloading this internet archive.

example.hanzi: 他靠什么维持生活？
example.pinyin: Tā kào shén me wéi chí shēng huó?
example.english: What does he do for a living?

example.hanzi: 不可以强迫任何人加入某个协会。
example.pinyin: Bù kě yǐ qiǎng pò rènhérén jiārù mǒugè xié huì.
example.english: No one may be compelled to belong to an association.

example.hanzi: 我们知道每个细胞都男女有别。
example.pinyin: Wǒ men zhī dào měigè xì bāo dōu nánnǚyǒubié.
example.english: We know that every cell has a sex.

example.hanzi: 这孩子有水痘的症状。
example.pinyin: Zhè hái zi yǒu shuǐdòu de zhèng zhuàng.
example.english: The child has a case of chicken pox.

example.hanzi: 专家正在试图找出气候变化的原因。
example.pinyin: Zhuān jiā zhèng zài shì tú zhǎo chū qì hòu biàn huà de yuán yīn.
example.english: Experts are attempting to find out the cause of climate change.

words.english: To push aside with the hand, foot, a stick etc / to dial

example.hanzi: 遇到紧急情况请立刻拨医院的电话。
example.pinyin: Yù dào jǐn jí qíng kuàng qǐng lì kè bō yī yuàn de diàn huà.
example.english: Please dial the hospital's phone number immediately in an emergency.

example.hanzi: 医生现在正在给那位患者就诊。
example.pinyin: Yī shēng xiàn zài zhèng zài gěi nàwèi huàn zhě jiùzhěn.
example.english: The doctor is seeing that patient.

example.hanzi: 船上有多少艘救生艇？
example.pinyin: Chuánshàng yǒu duō shao sōu jiùshēngtǐng?
example.english: How many lifeboats are on this ship?

example.hanzi: 我的手指头有一根刺。
example.pinyin: Wǒ de shǒu zhǐ tóuyǒu yīgēn cì.
example.english: I have a thorn in my finger.

example.hanzi: 你认为动物有灵魂吗？
example.pinyin: Nǐ rèn wéi dòng wù yǒu líng hún ma?
example.english: Do you think animals have souls?

words.english: Camera lens / camera shot (in a movie etc)
